notes.subject: larim
notes.rationale: ויגל em i jussive — 'bai/larim em i rol'; Tok Pisin i bruikim wanpela tok

notes.subject: kot na tsedek
notes.rationale: Ves bilong Amos i save tumas — parallelizim: kot olsem wara, tsedek olsem wara i tanim; namba tupela piksa i wok wantaim

notes.subject: warai bilong taim ren
notes.rationale: נחל em i bikpela wara bilong taim ren (i tanim taim tasol); איתן i tok em i stap olgeta taim

translation: Na larim kot i rol olsem wara, na tsedek olsem wanpela wara i no save dring.

tokens.gloss: olsem wanpela wara i tanim olgeta taim
